_comment: Configuration for cleaning imsg-named output. Each command defines fields to drop, keep, and transform rules for nested objects.

history._description: Message history cleaning. Removes internal identifiers and simplifies attachment/reaction metadata.

attachments._description: Simplify each attachment to only size and sticker flag. Remove field entirely if empty array.

reactions._description: Simplify each reaction to emoji and sender_name only. Remove field entirely if empty array.
